capabilities: Show a floating toolbar when text is selected
Run bound Obsidian commands and system shortcuts on the selection
Send selected text to AI models with custom prompt templates
Open external links and execute URL scheme commands
Organize and rearrange toolbar items into draggable groups
disambiguation: Not a command palette or quick switcher; the toolbar only appears when you select text in the editor.
extras: Beta installation is only documented via BRAT; AI features require connecting to external AI models. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
problem: Obsidian has no toolbar that appears when text is selected, so acting on a selection requires menus, hotkeys, or manual copy-paste into other tools.

relations.evidence: Seamlessly connect with AI models (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) to process selected text.
